excerpt.zh: 卑鄙的[From.GetName]渗透了我们的帝国。我们的空间站叛变，而他们已经在入侵我们的殖民地了。我们必须消灭冒名顶替者！
excerpt.en: The insidious [From.GetName] have infiltrated our empire. Our space stations are compromised and they are already invading our colonies. We must eliminate the imposters!

texts.zh: 卑鄙的[From.GetName]渗透了我们的帝国。我们的空间站叛变，而他们已经在入侵我们的殖民地了。我们必须消灭冒名顶替者！
texts.en: The insidious [From.GetName] have infiltrated our empire. Our space stations are compromised and they are already invading our colonies. We must eliminate the imposters!

texts.zh:
我们起先以为是某种故障。我们的半数通讯网络都陷入瘫痪。

但不是的，奸诈的[From.GetName]悄悄替换了整个星域的关键人员。我们的帝国支离破碎，殖民地遭到入闽。

不要相信任何人！
texts.en:
First we thought it was a glitch. Half our communication network blacked out.

But no, the duplicitous [From.GetName] replaced entire sectors of key personnel. Our empire is fractured and our colonies are being invaded.

Do not trust anyone!
